business_summary: Stride, Inc., a technology company, provides an educational platform to deliver proprietary and third-party curriculum, software systems, and educational services in the United States. The company offers online coursework and content in software engineering, healthcare, and medical fields, as well as state customized versions of those courses, electives, and instructional supports; end-to-end platform includes single sign-on capability for content management, learning management, student information, data reporting and analytics, and various support systems that provides an educational experience for students; and stand-alone products and services which can provide curriculum and content hosting on customers' learning management systems, or integration with customers' student information systems. It also provides instructional services that includes customer support for instructional teams comprising recruitment of state-certified teachers, training in research-based online instruction methods and Stride systems, oversight and evaluation services, and ongoing professional development; training options, such as hands-on training, on-demand courses, and support materials. In addition, the company offers support services, including marketing and enrollment, supporting prospective students through the admission process, assessment management, administrative support, technology, and materials support services. The company provides its products and services through virtual schools, traditional school districts, and consumer. It serves public and private schools, school districts, and charter boards, as well as employers, government agencies, and consumers. The company was formerly known as K12 Inc. and changed its name to Stride, Inc. in December 2020. The company was incorporated in 1999 and is headquartered in Reston, Virginia.
business_summary_ko: 기술 회사인 Stride, Inc.는 미국에서 독점 및 타사 커리큘럼, 소프트웨어 시스템 및 교육 서비스를 제공하기 위한 교육 플랫폼을 제공합니다. 이 회사는 소프트웨어 엔지니어링, 의료, 의료 분야의 온라인 교과 과정과 콘텐츠를 제공할 뿐만 아니라 해당 과정, 선택 과목 및 교육 지원의 주정부 맞춤형 버전도 제공합니다. 엔드투엔드 플랫폼에는 콘텐츠 관리, 학습 관리, 학생 정보, 데이터 보고 및 분석을 위한 SSO(Single Sign-On) 기능과 학생들에게 교육 경험을 제공하는 다양한 지원 시스템이 포함됩니다. 고객의 학습 관리 시스템에서 호스팅되는 커리큘럼 및 콘텐츠를 제공하거나 고객의 학생 정보 시스템과 통합할 수 있는 독립형 제품 및 서비스입니다. 또한 주 인증 교사 채용, 연구 기반 온라인 교육 방법 및 Stride 시스템 교육, 감독 및 평가 서비스, 지속적인 전문성 개발로 구성된 교육 팀에 대한 고객 지원을 포함하는 교육 서비스를 제공합니다. 실습 교육, 주문형 과정, 지원 자료 등의 교육 옵션. 게다가
